name: The Mad Mage of Mount Baratok
summary: A powerful wizard lives alone on Mount Baratok with his memory gone. Someone took it on purpose.

stages.journal: An old wizard lives in a stone hut on Mount Baratok, playing dragonchess against nobody. He doesn't know his own name, and the weather does whatever he forgets he told it to.
objectives: Find a way to give him back his memory

stages.journal: Under a warded cairn on the summit of Mount Baratok we found a spellbook in a strong, impatient hand, hidden by someone who didn't want it found, not even by himself.
objectives: Show the spellbook to the old man in the hut

stages.journal: Among Baba Lysaga's jars was one labelled in her scrawl: the wizard on the mountain, his remembering. Something silver moves inside it.
objectives: Take the jar to the hut on Mount Baratok

stages.journal: He remembers. His name is Mordenkainen. He came to Barovia to destroy Strahd, lost, and had his memory bottled by the witch of Berez.
Mordenkainen walks with us now. Madam Eva's cards called him the broken one. He is mending.
Mordenkainen is staying on his mountain to rebuild his spells. When we go up to the castle, he says, he will come.
